column1: # Two-sided contract evidence. Format: contract-id|polarity|exact Rust test name
# Every contract MUST carry at least one positive and one negative test.
# `supporting` evidence may supplement a pair but never replaces either side.
# New or renamed Rust tests must be registered here; existing unclassified
# tests are frozen in contracts-baseline.txt and cannot grow.
# A21/M7 authority declaration plus grant-event activation
# Spec §0/A16 canonical input domain: valid boundary integers retain their
# signed bytes; out-of-range integers, floats, collisions, and raw duplicate
# names produce neither a signed object nor an accepted verified object/event.
# Operator ledger inspection: listings expose signed event time and full
# records; invalid inspection targets fail without creating or changing state.
# Operator accounting consumes only a clean verified retained-row view;
# decodable anomalies stay inspectable, fail loudly, and create no drift/CAS/DB effect.
# Storage engine integrity: refuse WAL-reset-affected SQLite before creating
# W-13/§8 home-lifetime key continuity: creation is explicit and complete;
# reopen never replaces missing/malformed fabric, user-root, or owner-KEK
# material, and malformed credential storage is never treated as empty.
# W-14/RF-19 typed object application: signed raw must bind exactly to the
# requested id namespace, stored object kind, and expected verifying key before
# manifests, capabilities, tools, or channel objects can drive protected work.
# W-14/RF-20 restore preparation: every referenced CAS object is read and
# hash-verified into an immutable plan before any live store is mutated.
# W-14 independent-review remediation: runtime cache tables are never
# authority; only matched signed escalation/approval events plus pending
# in-memory dispatch reservations can widen a budget.
# W-14 coherent state transaction: signed event + expected roots + all live
# stores converge together under ordinary failure and restart recovery.
# Human approval applies only the exact candidate digest bound in a signed
# promotion escalation; mutable parking rows are selectors/caches only.
# tools/list exposes only capability surfaces that currently satisfy the same
# W-2 unified gate replay: the decision evaluator re-runs over signed
# records, clocked at each event's `at` (SI-22 at-the-time semantics).
# A15/§6 tool liveness: only a verified registration on the fabric-lifetime
# span with manifest:null can make a stored tool callable.
# W-9 foreign-trace corpus harness: conversion fails closed (quarantine
# leaves NOTHING in the substrate), and the pure replay is the
# A22/§5.4 capability closure: event-derived liveness at the durable
# authorization offset, shared by decision time and gate replay; permanent,
# prospective, descendant-closing; doubt never widens on either edge.
